entry.title: dotnet/runtime - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-10-24
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • GC.AddMemoryPressure ends an active NoGC region on NativeAOT (but not on CoreCLR) #136426
  • Does CVE-2026-111497 affect System.IO.Compression.Brotli in .NET 9 and 10? #136422
  • Tensor<T>.Unsqueeze(1) fails with 1-row 1D input #136420
  • Profiling API: no notification that a thread is running a debugger func-eval #136419
  • System.Net.Http: observable http.client.active_requests / open_connections leak two instruments per handler (regression from #131275) #136418
  • JIT: Dead code not removed after inlining - manual inline needed #136417
    Future
  • ILLink removes Monitor.Exit from async finally after empty filtered catch (.NET 10) #136414
  • [arm64] GC hole: JIT must kill the destination register right after adrp #136411
  • [API Proposal]: Extend configuration binding for delimited values #136409

Closed

  • VersionConverter.ConvertTo/From may fail with Version and InstanceDescriptor types #58331
    Future
  • Casting a second COM RCW to IEnumerator throws NullReferenceException in __ComObject.IEnumeratorOverEnumVARIANTImpl.MoveNext #136118
    12.0.0
  • [Proposal] Document that Linq-to-XML is thread-safe for multiple readers #123068
    Future
  • Clarification on .NET 10.0.13 Self-Contained Redistribution Licensing (Related to #108905) #136407
  • Regression_4.5.10: Assert failure: !CREATE_CHECK_STRING(!"Detected use of a corrupted OBJECTREF. Possible GC hole.") #134837
    12.0.0
  • [Question] Will coreclr implement remote debugger for any platforms? #136350
  • [x86] .NET 10.0.13: access violation in GetTLSIndexForThreadStatic (Internal CLR error 0x80131506), regression from #129785 #136317
  • Illink should use diasymreader nuget package #134847
    12.0.0
  • Test failure: JIT/Directed/tls/TestTLSWithLoadedDlls/TestTLSWithLoadedDlls.cmd #136262
  • Windows: legacy PKCS#12 export can return trailing bytes beyond the encoded PFX #136316
    10.0.x
